config.regions_unexplored.option.badland: Saguaro Cactis will generate in Badlands and Woodland Badlands.
Steppe Grass will generate in all Badlands.
config.regions_unexplored.option.basalt_: Ash Vents will generate in Basalt Deltas.
config.regions_unexplored.option.beach_p: Palm trees will generate in Beaches in warm areas.
config.regions_unexplored.option.birch_a: Birch trees will generate with Aspen shaping.
config.regions_unexplored.option.birch_o: Orange Coneflower patches will generate in Birch Forests.
config.regions_unexplored.option.branch_: Don't place any branches on trees that would usually have dedicated branch blocks.
Place RU's dedicated branch blocks on some trees.
Place log blocks in place of branch blocks on some trees.
config.regions_unexplored.option.brightn: The brightness of the rainbow colors.
config.regions_unexplored.option.common_: Grass Sprouts will generate alongside Short Grass in most biomes.
Shrubs will generate in a variety of biomes.
config.regions_unexplored.option.custom_: Peat and Silt dirt block families will generate in some RU biomes.
config.regions_unexplored.option.desert_: Sandy Grass will generate in Deserts.
config.regions_unexplored.option.forest_: Fancy oak tree will generate more frequently in Forests.
RU's tall flowers will generate in forested biomes.
config.regions_unexplored.option.jungle_: Bamboo trees will rarely generate in Jungles.
Elephant Ears will generate in Jungles.
Multiplier of falling leaf/needle particle spawn rates.
config.regions_unexplored.option.mangrov: Flowering Lily Pads will generate in Mangrove Swamps.
config.regions_unexplored.option.oak_tal: Regular oak trees generate 2-3 blocks taller.
config.regions_unexplored.option.painted: Re-enables the recipes of the legacy Painted Plank blocks.
config.regions_unexplored.option.plains_: Small bushes will generate in Plains.
config.regions_unexplored.option.prismar: Multiplier of prismarite sparkle particle spawn rates.
config.regions_unexplored.option.saturat: The saturation of the rainbow colors.
config.regions_unexplored.option.savanna: Small bushes will generate in Savannas.
config.regions_unexplored.option.small_o: Oak trees with thin fence-like log blocks will generate in some forests.
config.regions_unexplored.option.snowy_f: Frozen Grass will generate in snowy biomes.
config.regions_unexplored.option.swamp_c: Cattails will generate in Swamp and Mangrove Swamps.
config.regions_unexplored.option.swamp_w: Swamps will generate with rooted Willow and Oak trees.
config.regions_unexplored.option.taiga_p: Pine trees will generate with Pine wood blocks in all Taigas.
Purple Coneflower patches will generate in Taigas.
config.regions_unexplored.option.transit: The size of a rainbow color band in Eucalyptus logs. Bigger value = bigger distance between colors.
